name: Das Walchsee Aktivresort
beschreibung: The Walchsee Aktivresort is located on the north shore of Walchsee in Kaiserwinkl. The architecture combines alpine building elements with contemporary forms. The wellness area includes a lake sauna, an indoor pool and direct lake access. A lakeside bathing area as well as bike and tennis options complement the sports program. Childcare also allows parents a flexible daily routine. The dining options focus on regional products in several restaurants, including the Speckalm. The location at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser offers direct access to hiking and mountain biking trails.
